vb_textbox.text: It's important to stay focused on the game and be in a comfortable position as it takes quite a while! I chose randomly and thought that there would be a method in selecting certain coloured gnomes; however, it didn't seem to make much difference. I then started to notice whether the coloured baskets yielded more points than the others, and though I did think that the red ones collected more mushrooms, I can't be too sure. The purple gnome did appear to have higher numbers than the others though, so it may be worth following him around!The game gets a bit boring as the time goes on and I was a bit slow sometimes as I was trying to get a good look at the little gnomes as they are quite cute. Don't let that put you off though as you can quickly get refocussed, and after a short break, the second half of the study seems to fly by. It's also encouraging watching your total score of mushrooms increase and I managed to get over 1000 mushrooms!
